expectedRoute.rationale: The cutoff evidence describes a biotechnology company focused on cellular rejuvenation programming and preclinical research rather than marketed products.

binaryClaims.statement: Altos Labs publicly launched by the 2022-01-19 cutoff.
Shinya Yamanaka was identified as a senior scientific advisor to Altos.
Altos disclosed a commercial drug product at launch.

observableClaims.statement: Altos launched with USD 3 billion of committed or initial financing.
Altos announced initial sites in the San Francisco Bay Area, San Diego and Cambridge, UK, with Japan collaborations.
CiRA reported that Altos would fund Japan research projects in cellular rejuvenation programming.
